title: Publish HPCI inventory, specialized accelerators, and application forecast contracts
instruction: Update the public OpenFS roadmaps with a structured FY2026 HPCI system inventory and machine specifications; track wafer-scale, reconfigurable-dataflow, and other non-GPU AI accelerators while classifying Cerebras, SambaNova, and Graphcore accurately; and publish an EEA1 application-performance forecast contract using multiple Fugaku node scales, scaling modes, uncertainty, and Coverage Gaps without inventing numerical forecasts. Publish only public information and keep all outputs Consensus-incomplete until independent review.
